property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the TOCStyle.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the TOCStyle (a Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the TOCStyle within its containing object.

property.name: events
property.shortdesc: A collection of events.

property.name: eventListeners
property.shortdesc: A collection of event listeners.

property.name: tocStyleEntries
property.shortdesc: A collection TOC style entries.

property.name: titleStyle
property.shortdesc: The paragraph style applied to the TOC title.

property.name: title
property.shortdesc: The TOC title.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the TOCStyle.

property.name: runIn
property.shortdesc: If true, the lowest-level TOC entries are placed on the same line as the previous entry.

property.name: includeHidden
property.shortdesc: If true, the TOC includes entries from text on hidden layers.

property.name: includeBookDocuments
property.shortdesc: If true, includes the entire book in the TOC. If false, includes only the TOC entries in the current document. Note: Valid when the current document is part of a book.

property.name: createBookmarks
property.shortdesc: If true, creates bookmarks for TOC entries.

property.name: setStoryDirection
property.shortdesc: The table of contents story direction.

property.name: numberedParagraphs
property.shortdesc: The format for importing numbered paragraphs into the TOC.

property.name: makeAnchor
property.shortdesc: If true, make text anchor in source paragraph.

property.name: removeForcedLineBreak
property.shortdesc: If true, remove forced line breaks.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the TOCStyle.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
